user_observation: User is concerned that U and L are off-center to the displayed inner-plate opening circles and reports that the knobs look similar in size to the full diameters of those openings.
accepted_qualitative: Visible knob size appears comparable to factory inner-plate openings. This is not a caliper reading of knob, hub, bonnet or passing-section diameter.
interpretation: Factory mating axes must align. A large custom backing aperture does not independently validate concentric factory interfaces. The image prompted an audit of the original scan picks.
assistant_finding: The original U/L points are near the left edges of the captured tip caps. A separate projected cap-outline fit estimates centers about 3.1–3.4 mm farther right; it does not establish physical shaft axes, angular tilt or alignment at the plate plane.
preservation: No scan, transform, accepted R005 number, factory-hole coordinate or custom CAD coordinate was moved. Prior numeric fit calculations retain their original state but may not be interpreted as verified axis-center measurements.

screenshot.role: User-selected prior AP01 render; supplied as evidence of the modeling concern, not evidence of an installed plate.
